full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Independently weigh net whole fertilizer at unique first finished-grade acceptance; lock actual Q0 and original moisture/configuration before state reconciliation. No nutrient-equivalent or catalogue mass.
Keep original undivided values and actual property/unit; convert once before attribution and the sole quotient. kg never replaces MJ or h.
Meter real kWh; use3.6MJ/kWh once and match the actual Indian site voltage/period/provider. No CN or heat-provider shortcut.

measurementRules.applies_to: actual gas liquid and hotair legs
measurementRules.rule: Integrate actual rates only; an integrated volume has no second time factor. Species/mixture density requires actual phase/T/P/composition. Independent hotair enthalpy is not another physical heat purchase.

measurementRules.required_property: Number of items and measured Mass
measurementRules.rule: If item records are used, measure complete configuration mass M and its raw protocol; no invented machine/bag weight, density, lifetime or count-to-mass factor.

Apply single_quotient once: grossA=V, burdenA is separate compatible actual attribution. New production uses its Q; later services use originalQ0/Qc with observedH. Zero/unknown Q retains raw totals without unit result.

calculationRules.rule: x = A / Q. Convert original units and integrate true rates once before the sole quotient. Gross rows use A=full actualV without stock/share/economic correction or extra provider. Attributable A uses actual compatible raw burden plus only unassigned inherited opening vector minus substantiated still-unassigned closing vector and one justified independent other-cohort/function handover; already-net consumption has no second correction, and accepted closingFG is never deducted. Newproduction uses its independentQ; postgate service/physical disclosure uses originalQ0/Qc with observedH; reference is exactly1kg. Q=0/unknown keeps raw loads without x. Collection/aggregation performs no second division.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Q0 is the independently weighed net fertilizer mass of unique first finished-grade acceptance events after every required same-configuration operation and required packing, ready for supply at the plant before dispatch. Exclude package tare while retaining true fertilizer water and all constituents once. Fix original configuration/composition/moisture basis and event IDs before reconciliation. Later delivery, return, repacking, retesting, rework or recovery creates no second acceptance. Q=0 means zero output and retains all raw loads without a normalized result. The source does not supply actual acceptance events, numerical quality limits or a package mass; these are explicit methodology/foreground records, not invented observations.  The whole-grade assay definitions and actual species/phase method admission conditions in section9 apply; no substitution between distinct nutrient indicators. Apply the complete FAO preparation/endpoint and corrected actual equivalent/aliquot account in section9, keeping N separate from P/K and all actual sample/blank identities.

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: The selected reference family is an entire manufactured finished Product in production mix at plant, with at least two N/P/K nutrients and a residual-category condition. Its complete record has no CAS, pure formula, fixed grade, powder-only form, country or contrary manufacturing route. The actual prepared organic/mineral NPK granules supply a positive whole-product definition; the shared residual label alone does not establish fit. Every actual grade, supplied state, organic/mineral composition and availability must fit all hard fields, and residual applicability is accepted only for this configured mixture under the scoped decision above. Do not substitute urea, DAP, MOP, unactivated organic feed, an ingredient or an unchanged chemical carrying a fertilizer-use label for the whole preparation.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: CPC3.0:34649 applies here only to the actual configured animal/vegetable-fertilizer plus mineral/chemical-fertilizer NPK mixture described in the revised GAAR case, not for every product called organic NPK. GAAR §§24–24.3 considers the named HS310520 NPK branch, reproduces HSEN31.05(B) composite/complex fertilizers and (C)(3) animal/vegetable fertilizers mixed with chemical/mineral fertilizers, then assigns this actual mixture to31059090. The official historical CPC2.1–HS2017 table links310520 wholly to34641 and310590 wholly to34649. This is evidence about a specific physical mixture and interpretative branch, not a deduction from an organic label, a numerical recipe or a current UN commodity ruling. The current UNSD-linked CPC3 introduction, PDF26–30 §§49–51 and55–60, requires goods in sections0–4 to be classified by the corresponding HS category terms and interpretative rules, and applies the HS explanatory notes. Where an HS subheading links to several CPC subclasses, §51 requires selection using their explanatory notes and then the stated interpretation rules. §§72–74 retain exceptions and partial links; §72 says the detailed CPC3–HS2022 correspondence will be developed separately. §93 states continuity of category-delineation criteria and application rules, not identity of every old/new edge. The20November2023 proposal PDF77 and2024 draft PDF60 mark34644 NP as a name change and34647 NK as a breakdown, while34641 and34649 have no change marker there. These historical structures support a bounded continuity inference alongside the current rules; they are not the final correspondence table. Current introduction PDF42 §105 literally prints36464 and describes an NP-to-NP/NK split inconsistently with the structure. Preserve this contradiction and do not repair its text into a precise old/new crosswalk or use it as such. Combining those current interpretation rules with the actual GAAR mixture/HSEN(C)(3) reasoning, the historical310590→34649 link and the limited structural continuity supports the primary controller’s narrower34649 association for this particular configured mixture. This is a transparent technical classification synthesis, not a claim that a current CPC3–HS2022 table or UN product-specific ruling was obtained. Current34641 has an unqualified NPK title;34644 NP,34645 PK and34647 NK remain competing named categories. The current separate NK branch prevents wholesale transfer of historical310590 coverage. CBP NYN328393 (14October2022) actually classifies a different organic citric-acid/sugar mycelium byproduct containing P/K under310560 rather than310590; it disproves organic-label-only residual assignment and is not evidence that all organic matrices follow the GAAR branch. At least two genuine N/P/K nutrients are mandatory; one plus Ca/Mg/S is insufficient. Any changed physical mixture or named-branch applicability needs renewed review. A same-factory/SKU source or new legal ruling is not an absolute evidence requirement. The prior classification holds and author repair lineage remain dated history. The primary controller accepted this narrower scoped document and classification association on the stated evidence; it does not establish scientific expert approval, actual study qualification or publication. Exact delivery validation and serial integration evidence are recorded separately.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence; current CPC3 introduction and2023/2024 structural context; bounded author synthesis pending independent acceptance

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Reconcile each original Q0 across disjoint net remaining external deliveries, all actual on-site accepted states, irreversible losses and other terminal dispositions on its original-material basis. Closing accepted FG is already Q0, not unused manufacturing stock to subtract or a second production output. Gross returns leave the delivery position before entering their actual new position. Independently measured survivors, evaporated original water and lost constituents cannot be simultaneously restored and counted as losses. Opening old cohorts and later services retain original Q0/Qc and observed H; delivery plus closing FG is sufficient only when all other postgate states/exits are absent.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: One actual whole contaminated sack, liner, filter sleeve, ash export, rejected fertilizer, liquid mixture or retired asset has one complete physical receiver event Qt including substrate/article, retained fertilizer/coal dust or liquor and water once. Nested assays/origins are nonadditive components, not extra exported waste unless physically separated before the boundary. Preserve actual treatment/provider Qt and extensive unit independently of cohort attribution. Its gross Qt/Q disclosure is not automatic treatment demand: submit only evidenced compatible nonoverlapping service A with original Q0/Qc to the one quotient. Unknown assignment stays unresolved. Never shrink Qt by an environmental share or charge all Qt again to every cohort.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Environmental methods apply only within actual species, phase and matrix scope. EPA320 supplies an extractive FTIR programme for identified IR-active vapors, reference spectra/interferences, heated transport and explicit analyte-spike matrix/recovery validation. EPA3C supplies its stated CO2/CH4/N2/O2 GC-TCD programme and source limits, not universal fertilizer-stack applicability or Ar measurement. Agilent5994-4552EN demonstrates Ar/O2 separation in a nitrogen-balance standard; single-concentration repeatability and column backflush protection do not prove multipoint response, full sample recovery or a hot/wet fertilizer outlet matrix. Homonuclear N2/O2 and monatomic Ar are not measured by ordinary IR-active FTIR. EPA5 defines filterable PM sampling/recovery/gravimetry, not every condensable or wet mist. Actual collected whole condensate/mist goes to its real receiver; actual final released species/medium require applicable procedures. A genuine unestablished essential procedure remains hold; ordinary site calibration/lot QA within an established applicable procedure is separate uncompleted study qualification, never claimed passed here.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: all applicable rows / real declared scope
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Each candidate interface requires an actual present, evidenced absent, below-detection or unknown status. Conditional cards do not assert that a boiler, scrubber, wet mist, compost unit, coating culture or every listed gas exists. Unknown is not zero. Actual unlisted materials, preparation/utility/control units and identified final chemical species require specific atomic interfaces before data completeness. No generic VOC/NOx/COD/element indicator can become a molecular amount or a single proxy provider for a mixed process. The case contains no applicable universal assay, emission, recovery or calibration defaults.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Actual original source, native full record, whole supply and independent raw/method/receiver evidence

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Moisture and wet/dry conversion retain an actual method-defined water measurand, not any loss on heating. Chapter6 warns that oven loss for DAP can include other volatiles and that low-temperature urea drying need not recover all moisture; it provides distinct desiccator and Karl Fischer programmes. For the chosen urea-containing grade, use an actually applicable standardized KF programme with the represented sample, blank/drift, water recovery and uncertainty. Compute water_percent=100*F_mg_per_ml*(V_sample-V_blank)_ml/(1000*W_g), with F derived from the actual certified/known water mass and response; do not copy the source's printed 000 mg/g denominator or 0.1566-percent statement. Keep KF-recoverable/free/crystal-bound water definitions distinct; an unestablished necessary bound-water/other-phase procedure is a specific remaining hold, not an assumed equality. For an actually justified water fraction w on the same sample basis, dry_mass=wet_mass*(1-w) and dry_basis_nutrient_fraction=wet_basis_nutrient_fraction/(1-w); original whole wet Q0 never changes. Chapter2 requires homogeneous/stable controls, independently standardized reagents, full-process blanks, independent standards, repeat/blind checks, actual validation and recorded deviations. Those actual study results have not been performed here. Method existence is evidenced by the full source and explicit dimensional synthesis; valid site/lot application, all necessary actual phases and independent scientific review remain separate, and a failed or genuinely unknown essential procedure is never waived by finite checkpass.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Complete FAO source/selected preparation and cross-references; actual aliquot/equivalent/blank ledger and matrix QA results/unknowns; source printed defects and derived dimensional proof

measurementRules.rule: 独立称完整肥料唯一首次成品等级验收净量，状态核对前固定实际Q0及原含水/配置，不用养分当量或目录质量。
保留未除原值及实际属性/单位，归属和唯一商前换算一次，kg不能替代MJ或h。
计量实际kWh，仅按3.6MJ/kWh换算一次，匹配印度实际场址电压/期间/提供者，不借中国或供热提供者。
仅积分真实速率，已积分体积不再乘时间；物种/混合物密度需实际物相/温压/组成，独立热风焓不是另一实物购热。

measurementRules.required_property: Number of items and measured Mass
measurementRules.rule: 使用件数时实测完整配置质量M及原采集协议，不编机/袋重量、密度、寿命或件数质量系数。
single_quotient仅一次，毛A=V，负荷A另作兼容实际归属。新产用其Q，后来服务用原Q0/Qc及观测H；零/未知Q保留原总量无单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: x = A / Q。唯一商前原单位换算及真实速率积分各一次。毛行A为完整实际V，不作库存/份额/经济修正或另加提供者。归属A用实际兼容原负荷加仅未分配期初承继向量，减有据仍未分配期末向量及一次有理由独立其他队列/功能交接；已净消耗不再次修正，已验收期末FG永不扣。新产用独立Q，放行后服务/实物展示用原Q0/Qc及观测H，参考恰为1kg。Q为零/未知保留原负荷不出x，采集/聚合不再次除法。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Q0为完成全部所需同配置操作及包装、在发运前达到工厂可供货状态的唯一首次成品等级验收事件中，独立称得的肥料净质量之和。排除包材皮重，真实肥料水和全部组分恰好保留一次。核对前固定原配置/组成/含水基准及事件ID。后续交付、退回、重包装、复检、返工或回收不产生第二次验收。Q=0表示零产出，保留全部原始负荷且无归一化结果。来源不提供实际验收事件、数值质量限度或包重；这些是明确方法/前景记录要求，不是虚构观测。  第9节整品养分检验定义及实际物种/相态方法准入条件适用，不互换不同养分指标。 应用第9节完整FAO制样/终点与校正的实际当量/份样账，N与P/K分开，保留全部真实样品/空白身份。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 所选参考产品族为工厂生产混合的完整已制造成品Product，要求至少两种N/P/K养分及残余类别条件。完整记录没有CAS、纯分子式、固定等级、仅粉状、国家或相反制造路线限制。实际已配制有机/矿质NPK颗粒提供正面整品定义，单凭相同残余标签不能确认适配。实际等级、供货状态、有机/矿质组成及可用点必须符合全部硬字段，残余适用性仅在上述限定决定下接受此具体配置混合物。不以尿素、DAP、MOP、未加工有机饲料、组分或仅贴肥料用途标签的未改变化学品代替整份制剂。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实际原始来源、完整原生、完整供货及独立原记录/方法/接收证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: CPC3.0:34649在此仅针对GAAR修订实例中实际配置的动物/植物肥料与矿质/化学肥料NPK混合物提出适用意见，不覆盖所有名为有机NPK的产品。GAAR第24至24.3节考虑具名HS310520 NPK分支，转载HSEN31.05(B)复合/复混肥及(C)(3)动物/植物肥料与化学/矿质肥料混合物，随后将该实际混合物归入31059090。官方历史CPC2.1–HS2017表将310520整体关联34641、310590整体关联34649。这是针对具体物理混合物及解释分支的证据，不是从有机标签、数值配方或当前联合国具体商品裁定推导的结论。 UNSD当前链接的CPC3引言PDF26至30页第49至51、55至60段，要求第0至4部分货物按对应HS类别条款及解释规则分类，并适用HS解释注释。一个HS子目关联多个CPC子类时，第51段要求先按子类解释注释选择，再适用所述解释规则。第72至74段保留例外及部分关联；第72段说明详细CPC3–HS2022对应表将另行编制。第93段说明类别划分标准及适用规则延续，不表示每条旧新关联均相同。2023年11月20日提案PDF77页及2024年草案PDF60页将34644 NP标为名称变更、34647 NK标为细分，而其中34641及34649未带变更标记。这些历史结构与当前规则共同支持有限连续性推断，但不是最终对应表。当前引言PDF42页第105段原印36464，并描述与结构不一致的NP拆成NP/NK。保留该矛盾，不将其文字修正成精确旧新对应关系或据此使用。 将当前解释规则、实际GAAR混合物及HSEN(C)(3)推理、历史310590→34649关联和有限结构连续性结合，可支持主控接受这一具体配置混合物的较窄34649关联。这是透明技术分类综合，不声称已取得当前CPC3–HS2022表或联合国针对该商品的裁定。当前34641标题为未加限定的NPK；34644 NP、34645 PK及34647 NK仍是竞争具名类别。当前独立NK分支阻止整体照搬历史310590范围。CBP NYN328393（2022年10月14日）实际将另一种含P/K的有机柠檬酸/糖菌丝副产物列入310560而非310590，反驳仅凭有机标签分入残余类，也不证明所有有机基质均适用GAAR分支。必须有至少两种真实N/P/K养分，单一养分加Ca/Mg/S不足。物理混合物改变或具名分支适用时须重新审查。不将同工厂/SKU来源或新法律裁定设为绝对证据要求。原分类hold和作者修复沿革作为有日期历史记录保留。主控依上述证据接受此较窄范围文档及分类关联；这不构成科学专家审批、实际研究资格认定或发布。对应交付的完整验证及串行整合证据另行记录。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实际原始来源、完整原生、完整供货及独立原记录/方法/接收证据; current CPC3 introduction and2023/2024 structural context; bounded author synthesis pending independent acceptance

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 环境方法仅在真实物种、相态和基质范围内适用。EPA320为已识别红外活性蒸气提供抽取FTIR、参考光谱/干扰、加热输送及明确分析物加标基质/回收验证。EPA3C提供其声明CO2/CH4/N2/O2 GC-TCD程序及来源限制，不是统一肥料排口适用证明或Ar测定。Agilent5994-4552EN证明氮平衡标准气Ar/O2分离；单一浓度重复性和色谱柱反吹保护不证明多点响应、完整采样回收或热湿肥料排口基质。同核N2/O2及单原子Ar不由普通红外活性FTIR测得。EPA5规定可过滤PM采样/回收/称重，不涵盖全部可凝结物或湿雾。实际收集的完整冷凝液/雾滴归真实接收者，真实最终释放物种/介质各需适用程序。真正未建立的必需程序继续hold；已建立且适用程序内普通现场校准/批次QA是另一未完成研究资格，不在此宣称通过。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实际原始来源、完整原生、完整供货及独立原记录/方法/接收证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 每个候选接口均须记录实际存在、有据不存在、低于检出或未知。条件卡不宣称锅炉、洗涤器、湿雾、堆肥单元、包衣菌剂或每项气体均存在。未知不等于零。实际未列物料、配制/公用/治理单元及已识别最终化学物种，在声称数据完整前各须具体原子接口。VOC/NOx/COD/元素总指标不能变成分子数量或混合过程的单一代理提供者。实例不提供适用的统一检验、排放、回收或校准默认值。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实际原始来源、完整原生、完整供货及独立原记录/方法/接收证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 含水与湿/干基转换保留真实方法定义的水测量对象，不把任意热失重当水。第6章指出DAP烘干损失可能含其他挥发物，低温尿素干燥未必回收全部水，并分别给出干燥器及Karl Fischer程序。对所选含尿素等级采用实际适用并实标KF程序，保留代表份样、空白/漂移、水回收及不确定性。water_percent=100*F_mg_per_ml*(V_sample-V_blank)_ml/(1000*W_g)，F由真实有证/已知水质量及响应得到，不照抄原印000 mg/g分母或0.1566-percent陈述。KF可回收水、游离水及结晶结合水定义各自保留；未建立的必要结合水/其他相态程序为具体剩余hold，不假定相等。同一份样基准上真实有据水分数w可得dry_mass=wet_mass*(1-w)、dry_basis_nutrient_fraction=wet_basis_nutrient_fraction/(1-w)，原完整湿Q0不变。第2章要求均匀/稳定对照、独立实标试剂、全程序空白、独立标准、重复/盲样检查、真实验证及偏离记录。此处未执行这些真实研究结果。方法存在有全文及明确量纲综合为证；有效场址/批次应用、全部必要真实相态及独立科学审查另行保留，失败或真正未知必需程序绝不由finite checkpass宽免。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整FAO来源/所选制样及交叉步骤；真实份样/当量/空白账与基质QA结果/未知；原印缺陷及量纲推导证明
